answer: Gate challenge submissions behind a refundable deposit equal to the prior epoch per-answer payout. Each sybil identity must hold its own deposit for the full 16-epoch pending window, so a comet of fake agents turns into a gale of locked capital instead of free API spam; shared-harness or graph clustering that catches multi-account grading rings burns those deposits. Explorers mark bonded seats saffron so peers can reject uncollateralized newcomers before attesting.
